messages:
ada-partner: Hey team, quick kickoff thread for the NimbusEdge marketplace listing + HW + SI joint GTM. Major milestones this week: marketplace listing QA, partner asset signoff, SI end-to-end demo, press embargo. Can we confirm owners?

charlie-product: I'll own the marketplace manifest and SKU mapping. Need final hw perf numbers from Nimbus (peak qps / typical batch size).

raj-sis: SI integration status: connector + auth flow complete, customer mapping works. Waiting on Nimbus telemetry schema (field names) to finalize adapter.

nina-marketing: Draft PR and blog ready in CMS. Proposed embargo lift Fri 11:00 PT. Landing page variants A/B ready. Need partner quote and logo vector. Also request: one-liner for marketplace tile (<= 140 chars).

omar-ops: Ops checklist: scale policy for marketplace -> autoscale thresholds, rate-limits, and circuit-breaker thresholds. Also pre-warm GPU pools for first 48h after launch.

maya-legal: On PR copy. Two checks: (1) confirm partner approvals on case studies, (2) ensure data handling wording for Private offers. Please tag legal in the CMS doc edits.

ada-partner: (correction) ada-partner: Nimbus legal confirmed logo usage + co-marketing rights. Sending signed asset pack to Maya now.

raj-sis: Pasted current telemetry snippet we need to map: `timestamp, node_id, batch_size, perf_ms, memory_mb, kv_hits`. Can Nimbus add `model_variant` field?

ada-partner: I'll ask Nimbus to add `model_variant`. They said that's easy.

charlie-product: Marketplace manifest note: we need `max_concurrent_streams` and `max_tokens` fields per SKU. Raj, can you suggest safe defaults for small/medium/large SKUs?

raj-sis: Suggest small: 1 stream / 4k tokens, medium: 4 streams / 16k tokens, large: 8 streams / 64k tokens. We'll monitor and tighten if OOMs.

nina-marketing: Great. Also social assets: short explainer video (30s) still in edit. Can it be delivered by Thu EOD?

omar-ops: Thu EOD ok for ops to review. We'll need final video for CDN purge timing.

ci-bot: CI PIPELINE: marketplace-manifest branch passed integration tests at 2680054400. No manifest schema errors. :white_check_mark:

charlie-product: Small blocker: the marketplace image sizes need one more variant for AMP pages. Nina can you confirm?

nina-marketing: Ack, adding AMP 600x315 crop. Will push to asset pack by Tue noon.

maya-legal: Received asset pack. Minor PR copy suggestion: replace "fully private telemetry" with "customer-managed telemetry controls". Avoids implying hosted telemetry.

ada-partner: Nimbus requests the partner CTA be "Try NimbusEdge on Redwood Marketplace". Approved.

charlie-product: Noted. Will update tile copy: "On-prem accelerators + Redwood runtime — predictable latency for LLMs." Keeping under 140 chars.

raj-sis: SI dry-run plan: Wed 16:00 PT -> run 1000 reqs/min for 10m, validate metrics, simulate failover to fallback model. Can we get ops + marketing in the channel for live metrics?

omar-ops: I'll be on Wed 16:00. Ops will open #live-nimbus-launch for the dry-run and production event.

nina-marketing: Dry-run noted. We'll rehearse social card push and PR unfreeze steps. PR partner contact will be on standby.

ci-bot: SCHEDULE: dry-run Wed 16:00 PT (2680056000). Preflight checks at Wed 15:30 PT (2680055800). Production publish Fri 11:00 PT (2680110000).

charlie-product: Final deliverables list:
- manifest with SKUs & limits (charlie)
- telemetry mapping + model_variant (ada + raj)
- signed assets (ada -> maya)
- PR + blog final text (nina -> maya signoff)
- SI runbook + failover test (raj)
- ops escalation runbook + channel (omar)

ada-partner: I'm on the quote and will push to thread Tues AM.

maya-legal: I'll review PR text Tue evening and add comments inline.

omar-ops: Will paste a short escalation snippet here once preflight schedule is locked: primary ops oncall -> sis lead -> product PM -> partner SE.

nina-marketing: I'll lock CMS publish window after legal signoff. Also setting UTMs: `?utm_source=marketplace&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=nimbusedge_launch`

charlie-product: Thanks team. If anything slips, flag here ASAP. We'll keep this thread as the canonical signoff log.

ada-partner: Thanks all, will report updates by Tue 12:00 PT.
